answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 6344 Country: India Title: I am in bit trouble,I have TV at my home and I have stop watching it.My family members watch and I am insisting them from last six months to remove it and i am telling them the disadvantages of it but they are not listening to me.And I am going to get marry within few months and I don't want my wife to watch TV.So please advice me what to do. Question: Assalaamualeikum brothers, I am in bit trouble,I have TV at my home and I have stop watching it.My family members watch and I am insisting them from last six months to remove it and i am telling them the disadvantages of it but they are not listening to me.And I am going to get marry within few months and I don't want my wife to watch TV.So please advice me what to do. Zakaak-allah. Answer ID: 6344 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1252/1058=B/1429) Call reliable Ulama to your house and arrange their speeches. Also, study books written about the evils of television. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
